name: kiro-sidecar
description: Runs Kiro CLI agent sessions over the Agent Client Protocol from Claude Code.

api_key.title: Kiro API key
api_key.description: The Kiro API token. Every Kiro session, in docker and in local mode, uses it; while it is not set, every tool refuses.

proxy.title: Proxy URL
proxy.description: Optional. Sets HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, http_proxy and https_proxy for Kiro. Docker mode gets no proxy unless this is set and refuses a loopback host such as 127.0.0.1 or localhost; local mode inherits the server's proxy variables, and this value replaces them.

no_proxy.title: No-proxy list
no_proxy.description: Optional. Sets NO_PROXY and no_proxy for Kiro. Empty leaves the image's own list in docker mode and the inherited one in local mode.
